craft_direction: Awwwards-level, bold flat-illustration editorial aesthetic, kinetic typography, premium motion.
theme: Light base with dark contrast sections

scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none
scales.label: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-bold

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Do NOT use Inter or Roboto for headings.
Use kinetic text reveals for main headlines.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24.
layouts.grid_modes: Bento-style grids for Gallery and About features. Asymmetrical layouts with overlapping elements.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical alignment. Left-align dense text.

visual_enhancers.borders_and_shadows: Clipped frames for images. 1px solid borders for structure. Soft layered shadows for cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain texture overlay to enhance the editorial/print feel.
visual_enhancers.motion: Lenis for smooth scroll. Framer Motion for line-by-line text reveals and scroll-triggered fade-ups.

components.hero: Full height or 80vh. Uses provided background illustration with parallax effect. Large kinetic type with masked line-by-line reveal.
components.marquee: Slow editorial marquee used as a section divider. Large outlined text or serif text.
components.menu_tabs: Custom styled tabs (override Shadcn defaults). Active state uses terracotta or mustard.
components.menu_cards: Image on top or side, minimalist description, clean price tag. High-quality image treatments.
components.about_chapters: Numbered manifesto style (e.g., '01.', '02.'). Large serif numerals.
components.gallery_carousel: Framer Motion or Swiper. Large images, drag to scroll, hide scrollbar.
components.reservation_form: Minimalist inputs, bottom border only or softly rounded inputs. Custom select for time/date. Form validation.
components.navigation: Sticky nav with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#F9F6F0]/80). Do not use fully transparent nav.
components.footer: Large typography for CTA ('Let\'s Talk' or 'Reserve'). Dark theme (Charcoal bg).

motion_and_libraries.framer_motion: Required for kinetic typography (line-by-line reveal), scroll-triggered fade-ups, and smooth transitions.
motion_and_libraries.react_fast_marquee: For the slow editorial marquee text.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast or uses gradient overlays (e.g., bg-black/40).
accessibility.interactive: All interactive elements must have clear hover and focus states.
accessibility.testing: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive and key informational elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Playfair Display for headings and Manrope for body text.
Avoid standard Bootstrap-style columns; use asymmetrical, bento grids or overlapping layouts.
The Hero section MUST use the provided illustrations with a parallax effect and a large masked kinetic text reveal.
Use a pure light theme with specific sections set in Charcoal (#1E1E1E) for contrast.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; use backdrop-blur.
Incorporate the required sections: Hero, Intro (manifesto style with marquee), Menu (tabs and cards), About Us, Contact/Reservation Form, Gallery Carousel, Footer.
Forms should have custom minimalist styling with proper validation.
Images should have deliberate editorial treatments (e.g., clipped edges or specific aspect ratios).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters where appropriate.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
DO NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Do not use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Ensure the application structure follows a single-page marketing website flow.
Prioritize Shadcn components for complex interactions but heavily customize their appearance to fit the editorial brand.
